title: OpenAI Adds Parallel Agents to GPT-6 Astra Pro in ChatGPT
summary:
Users can now track the live progress of individual AI workloads and review specific task outputs within a newly updated interface. This functionality allows multiple autonomous entities to tackle different parts of a single request simultaneously, reducing the time needed for complex problem solving. The update, which is active in the Chat tab for Pro subscribers, also increases response speeds and improves the way the system integrates plugins and tools.

OpenAI released the features on October 16 for its GPT-6 Astra Pro model. An initial announcement from the company referred to the updated model as GPT-6 Pro before correcting the name to Astra Pro in a subsequent update.

GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT got an upgrade with faster responses and improved use of plugins and tools.

Now available to Pro users in the Chat tab.
